type.$description: Type scale: Tailwind v4's seven-step ladder, adopted as-is. The two load-bearing derivations are noted below because the virtualiser's row-height model reads them (INV-5).

f-ui.$description: Tailwind v4's default `font-sans`. No webfont: the UI face is San Francisco on macOS and Roboto on Android, which makes one build read as native on both.

f-mono.$description: Tailwind v4's default `font-mono`. The code, json, num and color content kinds render in it.

fs-xs.$description: Tailwind `text-xs`. Row meta line: 12 × lh-normal = 18px, which is META_LINE_PX in the row-height model.

fs-sm.$description: Tailwind `text-sm`, and shadcn's default control size. Row body: 14 × lh-normal = 21px, which is TITLE_LINE_PX in the row-height model.

fs-3xl.$description: Tailwind `text-3xl`. The pairing code, which has to be read aloud across a room.

fw-normal.$description: Tailwind `font-normal`; system faces need no product-specific correction.

lh-normal.$description: Tailwind `leading-normal`. LOAD-BEARING: TITLE_LINE_PX = 21 = fs-sm 14 × 1.5, and META_LINE_PX = 18 = fs-xs 12 × 1.5. The virtualiser reserves row height from both.

ls-none.$description: Tailwind `tracking-normal`, and the body default. A system face is drawn for its own metrics.

ls-wider.$description: Tailwind `tracking-wider`. The pairing code, grouped for reading aloud.
